title: FA4 pipeline structure: two-Q-tile ping-pong, P written back to TMEM, correction warpgroup

steps.title: Two Q tiles, two softmax warpgroups ping-pong (P still through shared memory), including causal
P aliased back into TMEM; P·V uses the TS form of tcgen05.mma
Separate correction warpgroup and setmaxnreg register redistribution

cases.name: n1
cases.purpose: N=1: one CTA, two Q tiles; all 128 rows of tile 1 are out of bounds (TMA fills zeros, store skips them); O = V, LSE = scale·q·k.

cases.name: one_block
cases.purpose: N=128: only tile 0 is valid, B>1, H>1: the coordinates of the 4-D tensor map and the grid mapping.

cases.name: two_tiles
cases.purpose: N=256 is exactly one tile pair, two K/V blocks, D=128: the Q coordinate of tile 1 (q0+128), the TMEM columns of S¹/O¹, the position of P¹.

cases.name: tile1_tail
cases.purpose: N=200: tile 1 has only 72 valid rows; the second K/V block has only 72 valid keys.

cases.name: tile1_position
cases.purpose: Non-causal, D=128, N=190: tile 1 has only 62 rows; V[j]=j/N exposes the packing order of P¹ (two adjacent keys swapped) and the TMEM columns of P¹.

cases.name: short_tail
cases.purpose: N=37, D=128: one row spans two 64-column panels; the 91 padding keys must be masked.

cases.name: scale
cases.purpose: scale=1, logits in the hundreds: scale must come from p.scale; without subtracting the max it overflows.

cases.name: uniform
cases.purpose: Q=0: O is the mean of V, LSE = ln N. Missing or repeating the multiply by α, or a wrong ℓ correction, all show up.

cases.name: ones_v
cases.purpose: V=1, 5 blocks, 3 CTA rows (tile pairs): the O correction and the ℓ correction must use the same α for O to equal 1; P of the padding keys must be 0.

cases.name: position
cases.purpose: V[j]=j/N, 5 blocks: a wrong item index of the K/V ring buffer (K even, V odd) or a wrong parity reads another block.

cases.name: peaked
cases.purpose: D=128, 7 blocks, large logits: the max is updated repeatedly; the O correction (α) must finish before PV.

cases.name: peaked_d64
cases.purpose: D=64, FP16: N=513 is 1 more than a multiple of the block; the TMEM columns of O¹ depend on D.

cases.name: ring
cases.purpose: 12 blocks, 24 ring items: the ring buffer wraps many times; a wrong full/empty parity reads an old block or hangs.

cases.name: medium
cases.purpose: Medium-size random data, D=128: a full ping-pong over 8 blocks.

cases.name: medium_d64
cases.purpose: Medium-size random data, D=64, FP16.

cases.name: causal_n1
cases.purpose: causal and N=1: the only query sees only itself.

cases.name: causal_pair
cases.purpose: causal, one tile pair, large logits: the second block of tile 0 is fully masked (must not produce NaN); the diagonal block of tile 1 must be masked.

cases.name: causal_tail
cases.purpose: causal and N not a multiple of the block: the diagonal mask and the tail mask apply at the same time; the second tile pair has only 44 rows.

cases.name: causal_n_bound
cases.purpose: causal, N=640: the block count of the last tile pair (rows 512..767) is set by N (5 blocks), not by the diagonal (6 blocks); tile 1 of that pair is fully out of bounds, and the last block of tile 0 has both the diagonal mask and the tail mask.

cases.name: causal_position
cases.purpose: causal, V[j]=j/N, D=128: a mask off by one reads the positional values of the future.

cases.name: causal_peaked
cases.purpose: causal and large logits: masked elements of the diagonal block must not take part in the max.

cases.name: causal_uniform
cases.purpose: causal and Q=0: O[i] is the mean of V[0..i], LSE[i] = ln(i+1).

cases.name: causal_ones_v
cases.purpose: causal and V=1: O must equal 1, including row 0, which has only one key.

cases.name: causal_medium
cases.purpose: Medium-size causal, D=128: tile pair p processes only blocks 0..2p+1.

cases.name: causal_medium_d64
cases.purpose: Medium-size causal, D=64.

cases.name: perf
cases.purpose: B·H=64, N=4096, D=128: 550 GFLOP, the same case as labs 22 and 34.

cases.name: perf_causal
cases.purpose: Same as above but causal: block skipping roughly halves the work.

cases.name: perf_d64
cases.purpose: D=64, FP16: half the MMAs per key, so the exponentials (MUFU) take a larger share.

cases.name: perf_8k
cases.purpose: N=8192, D=128: 64 blocks per CTA; the main loop dominates, and the prologue/epilogue matter least.
